observations: Single outdoor photo of a black electric bicycle taken from a distance.
Bike has a front basket, a rear passenger seat with backrest, and a battery pack mounted on the frame between the seat post and pedals.
No brand or model text is legible anywhere on the frame, battery, or any component.
No close-up of battery pack, display/controller, wiring, tires, or charger port is provided.
No charger, receipt, or box is shown.
Background is a grassy field with a paved path; watermark 'FAMOUS' overlays the image.

claims.evidence: No video or demonstration of the motor/pedal-assist functioning; only a static photo is given.
No photo of battery capacity label, charge indicator, or charging in progress.

risks.risk: Battery may be weak, dead, or near end-of-life, which is the most expensive component on an e-bike.
risks.proof: Close-up of battery capacity/voltage label plus a video showing it charging and powering the bike under load.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-working/weak battery (effectively a manual bike plus dead battery pack)

risks.risk: Motor/controller may not engage or may have intermittent faults.
risks.proof: Short clip of the bike being ridden with visible pedal-assist or throttle engagement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as electric assist not functional

risks.risk: Frame, fork, or wheel damage (dents, rust, bent rim) not visible at this distance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, fork, and both wheels from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear/cosmetic damage present

risks.risk: Charger may be missing, which is required to use the battery at all.
risks.proof: Photo of the charger unit alongside the bike.

risks.risk: Tire and brake condition unknown, affecting immediate usability.
risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread and brake pads/levers.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being ridden with pedal-assist/throttle engaged
Close-up of battery label (voltage/Ah) and a charging clip
Photo of the charger included in the sale
Close-up shots of frame, fork, wheels, and brakes for damage/rust
Photo of any brand/model marking on the motor hub or frame, if present
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an electric bicycle, but none of the functional claims (working motor, strong battery) are supported by photo or video evidence, so it must be priced at the worst case of a non-functional e-assist system with unverified frame/tire condition.
